Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
Here is a simple breakdown of the main options:
• 510 Carts (Oil Cartridges): The most popular and beginner-friendly choice. You buy pre-filled oil cartridges and screw them onto a 510-thread battery pen to use.
• Concentrates / Dabs: Uses wax or extract products. You load small amounts into a specialized atomizer bucket or dab pen for stronger hits.
• Dry Herb: Vaporizes raw ground flower without combustion, heating the bud to produce smooth vapor instead of smoke.

How do I use it properly the very first time?
Here is how to use your Ooze Twist Slim Pen step-by-step for the first time:
1. Charge & Register: Make sure your battery is charged using the included Ooze Smart USB Charger plugged into a wall outlet. Register your device online using the authentication code on the base to activate your warranty.
2. Attach Your Cartridge: Screw your 510-thread oil cartridge onto the top of the battery.
3. Power On: Click the power button 5 times quickly. The light will flash to confirm it's turned on.
